description: Declared mutants of camera phases, views of no camera, full-screen and depth-only passes, pass reads and the RP-3 assertion (render-pipeline declaration section 14, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a2; 判定 P1 to P9; render RD-4, RD-11, RD-12; RP-3). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The gf-, gd- and gt- mutants need a GPU (label gpu); gt-unwritten-not-asserted runs the skipped death case with --no-skip. Not added (with the reason): ui_render's pass in Overlay (no Engine module queues a PostProcess pass yet, so Overlay and PostProcess draw alike until A4's tonemapping; the phases' order is cp-phase-order-reversed); a full-screen pass's colour replaced, not blended (every test shader writes alpha 1, which blends the same); the depth format picked for drawing and sampling (every driver tried takes D32_FLOAT for both); a pass on a target of the wrong kind (a Programmer Error asserted, not tested: no guard against misuse, AGENTS section 3); the shader tool's --function (the tool is a separate host build; a table defined as EmbeddedShaders would not link with the Plugin's, so the test executable's link guards it). After the reviews (2026-11-27): retired rd-reads-depth-only-draws (a depth-only pass's MeshDraw has no texture), rd-depth-target-refused, rd-depth-linear-allowed and rd-depth-pixels-allowed (RenderTargetFormat and TextureFormat are two types: a Depth texture of pixels and an sRGB target cannot be written, and a Depth target takes no filter rule; design review S-2); added cp-written-not-first, rd-writes-3d-depth-dropped, gd-own-depth-sampled and the three rd-unwritten- of FirstUnwrittenRead. Not added: the depth-only pipeline key without blend (MeshDraw has no blend, so no change of one draw can split it; no count of pipelines is visible), a Depth target sampled by the nearest texel whatever its filter (the tests sample at texel centres, where linear and nearest agree). With 14.11 (target sizes on the data side, TargetUpdate, PassReuse): rd-unwritten-drawn-ignored retired (FirstUnwrittenRead is data alone, no drawn flags); added rd-reuse-not-written, rd-size-picture-kept, rd-picture-not-marked, rd-picture-by-reuse, re-update-disabled-ignored, re-update-picture-ignored, re-update-once-reused, re-main-size-not-set, wr-once-never-settled, wr-once-settled-unseen. Not added: a reuse recorded as nothing on the GPU (a pass that loaded the target would leave it as it is; [gf-reused-sampled] guards the picture), a size ask's texture made with no picture (new textures are zero on the drivers tried). After the reviews of 14.11 (14.12): the retain is RenderCommands::retained, not a pass (the rd-reuse-/rd-picture- ids kept); a 3D pass's depth target of another size is checked on the data side and skipped on the GPU (B-1); added rd-size-same-asked, rd-size-not-asked-again, rd-depth-size-unchecked, gd-size-ask-ignored, gd-depth-size-asserted, re-update-shared-waits, re-update-inactive-not-named; gt-unwritten-not-asserted and gt-unwritten-always moved to RenderContracts.hpp (the Plugin's check), the latter on the CPU case sdl_gpu contracts; gd-depth-pass-fresh-kept renamed gd-depth-pass-picture-not-given with the backend's flag. Not added: a frame the backend could not draw still taken as drawn (the data side's report stands until SDL-5 is decided, RC-A2-7).
